title: Easement, Inspection Certificate and Energizing Targets by Class — Line Extensions and New Service Construction
content:
Under **Line Extensions and New Service Construction**, Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative's construction and metering requirements differ by class of extension in four respects: whether recorded easements for every parcel the line crosses must be on file before construction is scheduled; whether a state electrical inspection certificate for the member's wiring must be on file before the meter is set; the largest age that certificate may have on the energize date; and the target number of business days from scheduling to energization.

## Requirements by class

| Class of extension | Recorded easements for every crossed parcel on file before scheduling | State electrical inspection certificate on file before energizing | Largest age of the certificate on the energize date | Energizing target after scheduling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 30 business days |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 35 business days |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 30 business days |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 30 business days |
| Irrigation Well Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 45 business days |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | Required | Required | 180 calendar days | 60 business days |
| Temporary Construction Service | Not required | Required | 180 calendar days | 10 business days |

## Notes

- The easement requirement applies on every class except the Temporary Construction Service.
- The inspection certificate requirement applies on every class, and the certificate's age is counted in calendar days back from the energize date.
- The energizing target is counted in business days from the date construction is scheduled, and it is a target.

## Certificate age (hypothetical dates)

| Certificate date relative to the energize date | Age on the energize date | Within 180 days |
|---|---|---|
| 179 calendar days before | 179 days | Yes |
| 180 calendar days before | 180 days | Yes |
| 181 calendar days before | 181 days | No |
